views.markdown:
Small SpringBoard, lockscreen, Control Center and Photos changes in one place.

* hide Edit Home Screen, Share App & Remove App.
* show which dock apps are running.
* hide the home bar.
* hide the screenshot preview & mute the shutter.
* count notifications in each group.
* haptics on the passcode keypad.
* color the connectivity toggles.
* arrange the connectivity toggles in any grid.
* pick a Default or Grid app switcher, its card size, position & spacing.
* hide the Handoff banner.
* show the status bar in the switcher.
* clear all apps with a swipe down or a button.
* delete photos without confirming & zoom in further.
* speed up animations & remove their bounce.
* set the space apps leave above the home bar.
* set Custom Bottom Inset in points, and apply it in portrait only.
* allow installing on iOS 17 and later.
* fix LINE crashing when a note is opened with Custom Bottom Inset on.
* add Disable Camera Swipe, Disable Camera Button, Hide Camera Button, Disable Flashlight Button and Hide Flashlight Button.
* fix a Speed Up Animations change missing animations that had already run.

* show the package icon after install.
* add a Tip on Ko-fi row to the credits.
